She and [[Phyco]] play a central role in {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Pokémon Ultra Moon}}. ==In the core series games== ===Role=== Soliera is a member of the [[Ultra Recon Squad]] and a resident from [[Ultra Megalopolis]], a world that has lost its light. She is always seen accompanying her partner and captain, [[Phyco]]. ====Pokémon Ultra Sun==== Soliera stays behind with Phyco in Ultra Megalopolis, while [[Dulse]] and [[Zossie]] conduct their research in Alola. She is first encountered upon arriving to Ultra Megalopolis, and will direct the player to the Megalo Tower in order to quell {{p|Necrozma}}. Following its defeat, Soliera will gift the player a {{p|Poipole}}. ====Pokémon Ultra Moon==== {{incomplete|section}} Soliera and Phyco are encountered throughout the player's journey in Alola, where the pair are conducting research on [[Z-Crystal]]s. They first appear outside of [[Iki Town]] while on the way to the festival, but do not formally introduce themselves until after the first trial in [[Verdant Cavern]]. In [[Seaward Cave]], Soliera battles the player, using a Pokémon caught in Alola, to experience firsthand what a Pokémon battle is like. She later challenges the player again in Paniola Ranch, this time using a more familiar Pokémon, {{p|Poipole}}. After the player battles the {{p|Nihilego}} that appeared in [[Aether Paradise]], Soliera and Phyco arrive. ===Pokémon=== Soliera is battled exclusively in {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Pokémon Ultra Moon}}. {{color2|fff|Pokémon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Soliera/Quotes}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Soliera Adventures.png|thumb|120px|Soliera in Pokémon Adventures]] Soliera debuted in ''[[PASM27|Meeting the Ultra Recon Squad]]''. She was first seen receiving a call from [[Dulse]], who reported that he and [[Zossie]] lost the [[Nebby|Lunala]] they were using to traverse through [[Ultra Space]]. As they talked, Soliera checked on the condition of {{p|Necrozma}}, who was in pain despite having absorbed {{p|Solgaleo}} to become its {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dusk Mane}} form. In ''[[PASM28|Arrival at the Scientific Megalopolis]]'', Zossie arrived at the [[Ultra Megalopolis]] with {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}}. Shortly after, a {{p|Stakataka}} appeared, looking to battle with Necrozma. Wanting to see if the bonds between Trainers and their Pokémon could lead to a solution that would restore light to the Ultra Megalopolis, Soliera lured Stakataka to the [[Megalo Tower]], forcing Sun and Moon to battle it. After Stakataka was defeated, Necrozma was alerted to Lunala's presence. Necrozma released Solgaleo and leapt off of the Megalo Tower to try and absorb Lunala as well. Sun and Moon tried to assist Lunala, but were stopped by [[Lusamine]]. A comment from Sun angered Lusamine, who sent out a {{p|Nihilego}} and had it fuse with her. In ''[[PASM31|Ray of Light!! Through the Crack in the Sky!]]'', Necrozma fled to the top of Megalo Tower while Lusamine chased after it. Zossie and the others tried pursuing them, but were sucked into an [[Ultra Wormhole]] Necrozma made, dropping everyone into the skies above [[Mount Lanakila]]. Soliera and the others later witnessed Necrozma battling against {{adv|Zygarde}} in its Complete Forme. During the clash, Necrozma opened a wormhole, summoning Dulse to Alola. It absorbed the [[Ultranecrozium Z]] Dulse had with him, allowing Necrozma to transform into Ultra Necrozma. The Ultra Recon Squad decided the best option to stop Necrozma was to capture it, but due to Lusamine's meddling, there were no [[Beast Ball]]s left to use. [[Nanu]] stated he could have another Beast Ball delivered, but told Sun and Zygarde to keep Necrozma busy while they waited for it to arrive. Later, Moon joined in the battle, and with a combined attack from Zygarde, Lunala, and Solgaleo, Necrozma was finally downed. [[Anabel]] arrived with the final Beast Ball, but it was destroyed when Necrozma launched one final attack. Sun revealed he picked up the Beast Ball Moon tried using on Lusamine earlier, which Anabel decided to let Zossie use. Zossie captured Necrozma with the Beast Ball, hoping that it could one day be healed of its injured state. Several months later, Soliera rejected the [[Aether Foundation]]'s request to do cooperative research with them, stating she would only do so with Moon. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Soliera is left-handed. * During every first turn of battle, Soliera will use an [[X Sp.
